query: 灵活工作安排 灵活工作安排 衡量企业在远程/弹性办公方面的制度与执行。 一、 内容质量得分 (权重 50%) 衡量制度的专业性与可执行度，防止“口头承诺”而无制度保障。 2分：卓越（三要素齐全） 制度清晰： 明确定义了弹性工时、远程办公或压缩工时（如 4.5 天工作制）的具体形式，针对特殊员工群体有单独的配套措施。 适用边界： 清楚界定了哪些岗位适用、申请流程及审批权限，具有极强的操作性。 绩效协同： 建立了“以结果为导向”的考核机制，确保灵活办公不影响协作效率（如配套的线上协作工具、核心协作时间规定）。 1分：合格 包含一个或两个 0分：缺失 未披露任何相关信息，或企业文化明确强调全员必须现场打卡且无弹性空间。 二、 覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%,) 衡量制度的穿透力，即多少员工真正受益。 2分：全覆盖与高穿透 覆盖率： 机制覆盖 100% 符合岗位性质的员工（如非生产一线人员全覆盖）。 执行数据： 披露了实际使用灵活办公人数占符合条件人数的比例。 满意度： 披露了针对灵活办公效果的员工满意度调研结果。 1分：合格 提及个别案例或极少数特殊岗位（如孕期员工）可申请。 0分：不满足/无数据 无法证明制度已在实际中得到应用。 灵活工作安排 弹性工时 远程办公 混合办公 居家办公 压缩工时 核心协作时间 弹性工作制度 WFH hybrid work flexible working flexible working hours remote work hybrid work work from home compressed workweek core collaboration hours flexible work arrangement WFH 企业是否定义弹性工时、远程办公或压缩工时等具体形式？ 适用岗位、申请流程与审批权限是否明确？ 是否建立结果导向考核或核心协作时间等配套？ 披露了多少符合条件员工实际使用灵活办公？ 是否有相关满意度结果？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '灵活工作安排'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 企业是否定义弹性工时、远程办公或压缩工时等具体形式？ 适用岗位、申请流程与审批权限是否明确？ 是否建立结果导向考核或核心协作时间等配套？ 披露了多少符合条件员工实际使用灵活办公？ 是否有相关满意度结果？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有加班管理；仅有育儿假/产假制度；仅有居家办公临时防疫安排；仅有企业文化宣传无制度；区分：灵活工作安排关注远程/弹性办公制度与执行；反歧视政策关注禁止歧视；平等机会措施关注招聘晋升选拔公平流程，三者不可互相替代。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.section: People-oriented Workplace / Merit-based Remuneration and Promotion
results.text: Based on the Group's business nature, both standard and flexible work hour systems are adopted to suit the operational needs. To ensure appropriate work and rest schedules are arranged for employees, the Group stipulated the working days, normal working hours, and rest periods of employees in the Attendance Management Standard and it includes the appropriate arrangement of providing monetary compensation or granting of time off to compensate overtime work. The Group guarantees that all employees enjoy statutory holidays such as marriage leave, maternity leave, funeral leave, and paid annual leave.
results.retrieval_text:
[Section]
People-oriented Workplace / Merit-based Remuneration and Promotion

[Content]
Based on the Group's business nature, both standard and flexible work hour systems are adopted to suit the operational needs. To ensure appropriate work and rest schedules are arranged for employees, the Group stipulated the working days, normal working hours, and rest periods of employees in the Attendance Management Standard and it includes the appropriate arrangement of providing monetary compensation or granting of time off to compensate overtime work. The Group guarantees that all employees enjoy statutory holidays such as marriage leave, maternity leave, funeral leave, and paid annual leave.

results.text: The Group strictly follows labour laws and regulations in areas where it operates and prohibits any form of child labour or forced labour. To prevent forced labour, the Group properly regulates employees' working hours and rest periods. We would never force employees to work against their wills with violence or intimidation, or by restricting their freedom. To avoid child labour, the Group requires candidates to provide proof of identity and candidates without a valid identity proof would not be considered. results.section: People-oriented Workplace / Safety and Health
results.text: The Group provides adequate and personal protective equipment to employees based on their nature of work. Understanding fatigue can affect employees' health, safety and work performance, the Group prevents fatigue accidents in the workplace by establishing reasonable work arrangements to avoid excessively long shifts. In addition, the Group provides employees with common rooms, and adequate breaks for them to take rest. To protect our drivers' health, the Group installs air cushions in the driver's cab of terminal tractors for shock absorption, providing greater comfort and stability while reducing drivers' spinal stress when driving.

[Content]
The Group provides adequate and personal protective equipment to employees based on their nature of work. Understanding fatigue can affect employees' health, safety and work performance, the Group prevents fatigue accidents in the workplace by establishing reasonable work arrangements to avoid excessively long shifts. In addition, the Group provides employees with common rooms, and adequate breaks for them to take rest. To protect our drivers' health, the Group installs air cushions in the driver's cab of terminal tractors for shock absorption, providing greater comfort and stability while reducing drivers' spinal stress when driving.

results.text: The Group offers a comprehensive remuneration package to employees with reasonable terms. The Group conducts performance review according to the Regulations on Employee Performance Review, and promotes employees based on their working performance. The review also enables management to assess what employees have accomplished and provides recommendations on how to achieve career goals. The Group has formulated the Employee Promotion Management System to govern the promotion criteria and procedures, and to encourage employees to enhance their capabilities.

results.text: The Group has established a c o m p r e h e n s i v e t e n d e r evaluation system and set out a supplier selection process in the Tender Management Measures and Procurement Management Process , which regulates the management of different types of suppliers to the Group and realises the principles of 'transparency, fairness, impartiality and honesty'.
